capabilities: sync reciprocal relationship properties in YAML frontmatter
render interactive multi-generational family trees from note metadata
trace the shortest relationship path between two people in a graph
restrict syncing and graphing to selected folders with exclusions
extras: The README flags the plugin as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and recommends installing via BRAT for beta testing; it also stresses the sync engine only writes to frontmatter, never note bodies.
problem: Obsidian links and properties are one-directional, so keeping relationship metadata (e.g. father/son, mentor/mentee) reciprocal across person notes requires manual edits on both notes.
summary: Three-part suite that auto-syncs reciprocal relationship properties between notes and renders interactive family tree and relationship-path graphs.
